model.card: Qwen3.8-27B incumbent at UD-Q5_K_XL, 64K context, preserve_thinking, grammar-constrained tool calls

sampling.note: null = llama.cpp server default, frozen as served and recorded at serve verification (M2)

suite.selection_rule: order the pool by SHA-256 of "needle-01:" + instance_id ascending; take the first 3 (rank 1-2 = wave 1, rank 3 = wave 2)

scaffold.note: H1-H3 as frozen in harness commit 1747c25ab022bae8fb64a929d985998f14fdb04d; no in-loop self-critique (H4 held out)

waves.wave2: rank 3, one attempt, only when wave 1 produced a registered edit but no resolved delivery AND the remaining sub-cap admits a full attempt cap

pass_bar: A pair PASSES Stage A when, across its probe waves, it produces at least one registered repository edit AND at least one graded resolved delivery, with the instrument clean (no equipment-caused zero in the counted evidence).

outcome_table.consequence: the pair is eligible for the Stage B selection rule

outcome_table.outcome: edits registered, no resolved delivery after wave 2
outcome_table.consequence: the pair does not pass; its ladder position is reported (the model engages the repository but does not yet land a fix at probe scale)

outcome_table.outcome: no registered edit across both waves, instrument clean
outcome_table.consequence: a behavioral fail for this pair at probe scale, with the full transcript record standing behind it

outcome_table.outcome: format-path failure (no valid tool call ever parses)
outcome_table.consequence: equipment-blocked, never a behavioral fail: fix the bridge for that pair and re-probe inside the pair's remaining allocation

grading: official SWE-bench evaluation only; per-task controls (gold patch resolves, empty patch does not) run and recorded before any probe is scored
serve_verification_notes: Grammar-constrained calls were tested at serve verification and rejected on evidence: the grammar routed the action JSON into the reasoning channel (empty content). Pair D is served with preserve_thinking honored and no grammar constraint.
